newsitem.title: USA: U.S. MUNICIPAL FOCUS - prices close up 1/4 to 3/8.
newsitem.headline: U.S. MUNICIPAL FOCUS - prices close up 1/4 to 3/8.

text.p: U.S. municipal bond prices ended up 1/4 to 3/8 of a point, aided U.S. Treasury bonds' full point gain, market sources said.
"Munis gave a good showing today," one trader said, adding that "there was a lot for sale also."
Bid lists totaled "maybe $300 million," and it appeared that some players opted to sell into Tuesday's strength, he said.
"I think the smart people let a few go in here," he said.

A municipal analyst said while the overall market was up 1/4 to 3/8, high-grade issues improved by three basis points. Dollar bonds had been up 3/8 to 1/2 at noon, but faded slightly to close the session up 3/8.

In the government market, the 30-year benchmark closed up 32/32 at 102-4/32 to yield 6.59 percent. In debt futures, the December municipal contract closed up 13/32 at 116-19/32. The December T-bond closed up 25/32 at 113-25/32. The MOB spread was 90 ticks.

As for new issues, the analyst described pricing as "strong...especially the Goldman deal." Goldman Sachs & Co said it repriced a $265.2 million California Department of Water Resources bonds, cutting yields in several maturities. Goldman cut the top yield in 2029 to 5.72 percent from 5.73 percent.
A source familiar with the offering said the deal was "in very good shape," and that since Friday Goldman had been contemplating bringing the deal as early as Tuesday.
"The market obviously was rallying, so it was a great day to come," he said.
Also Tuesday, Smith Barney Inc said it repriced Central Coast Water Authority, Calfornia's $194.3 million refunding revenue bond issue. The top yield was 5.85 percent in 2022.
"The deal went well, (it) saw a lot of interest from institutional buyers, some insurance companies and trust departments," a source familiar with the offering said.
The offering was unscheduled according Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group's calendar.
"It was market conditions which brought it to market," the source familar with the deal said.
